summary.key_theme: Meta 憑藉 Muse AI 代理的強勁表現與商業化潛力推動股價，但面臨 OpenAI 的激烈競爭以及稅務合規性挑戰。

bullish.title: META Eyes Best Month Since 2013 On Muse AI Strength
bullish.reason: Muse AI 的成功推動了 Meta 股價創下自 2013 年以來的最佳月度表現，市場對其 AI 代理的成長潛力持高度樂觀態度。

bullish.title: Mark Zuckerberg's Muse Could Charge You for Saving You Money — META President Reveals AI Agent's Potential Monetization Model
bullish.reason: 總裁 Dina Powell McCormick 明確指出 Muse AI 將透過節省用戶成本抽成及訂閱制進行變現，為 AI 業務提供了清晰的獲利路徑。

bullish.title: Meta launches Muse for Small Business as Zuckerberg pushes beyond consumer AI market
bullish.reason: Meta 將 Muse AI 擴展至小型企業市場，顯示其業務觸角已從消費端延伸至高價值的企業級應用。

bullish.title: BofA warns Meta's Muse could threaten Apple
bullish.reason: 美國銀行分析指出 Muse AI 可能對 Apple 的生態系統構成威脅，側面印證了 Meta 在 AI 領域的競爭優勢。

bullish.title: In AI Race, Software Is Now Winning Alongside Chips
bullish.reason: 分析指出 Meta 的軟體服務不僅增加對晶片的需求，更在 AI 軟體競賽中取得領先地位。

bullish.title: Unity Software Surges 5% as Traders Weigh Meta Platforms VR Glasses Support
bullish.reason: Unity 宣布支援 Meta 下一代 VR 頭戴裝置，顯示 Meta 在硬體生態系統的影響力持續擴大。

bullish.title: Meta Platforms Is Making a Push Into AI Hardware. History Says Apple Investors Shouldn't Worry.
bullish.reason: Meta 持續在實體裝置領域布局，展現其軟硬體整合的長期戰略企圖。

bullish.title: Meta Platforms President Dina Powell McCormick goes one-on-one with Jim Cramer
bullish.reason: 高層透過媒體曝光強化市場對 Muse AI 策略的信心，有助於穩定投資人情緒。

bearish.title: Meta counted Mark Zuckerberg’s $4.1B stock payout as research pay to claim a $355M tax break — and the IRS wants it back
bearish.reason: 公司因稅務申報問題面臨 IRS 追討，涉及金額龐大且可能引發監管審查，對公司財務信譽造成負面影響。

bearish.title: Meta Stock Slides as Muse Faces OpenAI Threat
bearish.reason: OpenAI 進入個人代理市場直接威脅 Meta 的核心產品 Muse，導致股價出現短期回調。

bearish.title: Meta reportedly calls its AI data centers ‘pilot models’ — its research tax credits jumped from $700M to $3.9B
bearish.reason: 關於研發稅收抵免的爭議報導，可能引發監管機構對 Meta 稅務規劃合理性的進一步調查。

bearish.title: Meta Platforms (META) Registers a Bigger Fall Than the Market: Important Facts to Note
bearish.reason: 股價表現弱於大盤，反映出市場對近期競爭壓力的擔憂與獲利了結賣壓。

bearish.title: Meta Faces Challenge in Enterprise Market As OpenAI Launches Autonomous Dots Agents
bearish.reason: OpenAI 的新產品進一步擠壓 Meta 在企業級 AI 代理市場的成長空間。

bearish.title: VIG Cannot Own Meta’s or Alphabet’s Dividends Until 2035 at the Earliest: The 10-Year Rule Written Into Its Index
bearish.reason: 指數編制規則限制了 Meta 被納入特定股息 ETF，可能影響長期機構資金的配置需求。

neutral.title: Google, Anthropic, Meta, Nvidia, OpenAI, xAI Executives Sign White House Accord on 'Super Intelligence'
neutral.reason: 參與白宮關於 AI 安全的協議屬於產業標準行為，對單一公司股價影響有限。

neutral.title: Alphabet Rides on Google Services Growth: Can It Beat META & AAPL?
neutral.reason: 僅為同業競爭分析，未提供關於 Meta 本身的新重大資訊。

neutral.title: Alphabet vs. Meta Platforms: Which Media Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
neutral.reason: 屬於投資建議類型的比較分析，對股價無直接驅動作用。

neutral.title: OpenAI follows Meta into the red-hot market for personal agents. But will users pay?
neutral.reason: 探討市場趨勢與用戶付費意願，屬中性產業觀察。

neutral.title: Top-Ranked Apps Like Muse AI Send Meta Shares Soaring
neutral.reason: 回顧性報導，強調過去的漲幅，對當前股價影響中性。

neutral.title: Bank of America warns Apple investors because of Meta's Muse
neutral.reason: 重複報導美銀對 Apple 的警告，對 Meta 本身無新觀點。
